text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! ...42 seconds. All right, good. Time 
for an interval.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! What incredible speed! And to be 
training in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Every minute and every second is precious 
to me. Today, I will surely reach it. 
...The 'Fastest Day.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking for a while now. I 
don't need 24 hours. I ought to be able to 
finish things much sooner.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"From the moment I wake up until I fall 
asleep at night. I want to blaze through 
life with the weapon I possess: 'Speed.'"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The domain of 'top speed' that no one has 
ever seen. The one who will step into 
it... is me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The fastest—so you wish to master pure 
speed! That truly is the strongest! Speed 
triumphs over all!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That attitude of dashing through the day 
faster than anyone else! Truly the mark of 
an exemplary Bakushin student!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll spend the day at full throttle too! 
I'll blast through reviewing my lessons at 
lightning speed! All five subjects in five 
minutes—no, five seconds flat!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then give me three seconds. I won't 
surrender the title of the fastest to 
anyone. I'll sprint through today at the 
fastest speed in the world.
